run_f_gold: run f_gold to find n where sum of squares 1^2 to n^2 equals s
test_f_gold: test f_gold against known square pyramidal numbers like 1, 5, 14, 140, 204, 506
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which computes the square pyramidal number n for a given sum s
review_f_gold: review f_gold reference solution that returns n or -1 for square pyramidal number sum
refactor_f_filled: refactor the TOFILL f_filled function to match f_gold square pyramidal number logic
